mapper.select: select bt.id, bt.tariff_category_id as tariffCategoryId, btc.`name` as tariffCategoryName, btc.number as tariffCategoryNumber, bt.item_number as itemNumber, bt.`name`, bt.pinyin, bt.english_name as englishName, bt.unit, bt.price, bt.inservice from base_tariff bt left join base_tariff_category btc on bt.tariff_category_id = btc.id where bt.id = #{id}
